terms: Packages are available on certain weekend dates and times — please call for details.
We can help organise competitions such as longest drive and nearest the pin.
A deposit is required when booking. Please call 7 days before your golf day to confirm numbers.
If guests do not turn up on the day, 100% of their food cost will be charged.
If numbers fall below 12, the daily green fee rate will apply.
